# Vendored Motion Lab

Upstream: https://github.com/dantegaleazzi/motion-lab
Source revision: `1b96227c542a7c2c934290be3e02ee7572e0882c`
Source files: `motion.js`, `scene.css`, and `LICENSE` (MIT).
Imported unchanged on 2026-11-26. The Seiyun wrapper supplies only authenticated owner photographs/data.
The six modes are Portal, Orbit, Cascade, Tunnel, Carousel and Marquee.
Motion Lab provides browser animation; the Seiyun Studio owns export logic separately. Sample imagery and audio are not imported.
